reason: In config/routes.rb:49-50, `delete "members"` and `put "members"` sit directly inside the `resources :groups` block, not inside a `member do` block. Rails therefore treats them as nested routes, `/admin/groups/:group_id/members`, so `params.require(:group_id)` in app/controllers/admin/groups_controller.rb:617 and :644 reads the right key.
